gripOrHq.title: Priority Wreck
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

gripOrHq.title: Loan from Chiba
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

heapOrArchives.title: Security Code WORM Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
rig.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

scoreArea.title: Corporate War
scoreArea.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

root.title: Systematic Layoffs
root.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Systematic Layoffs

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

ice.title: Misleading Access Menus
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Misleading Access Menus.
